decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed loft dormer within the rear roof slope and insertion of two rooflights in the front roof slope would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 29 Thorney Hedge Road and surrounding dwellings. The character of Thorney Hedge Conservation Area would be preserved. The minor departures from the Residential Extension Guidelines are justified and the development is considered to comply with the UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The proposed roof lights to be installed in the extension should be conservation style, flush fitting with the roof slope.
description: Erection of roof extension to first floor flat.
